name: Desklog
description_en:
Desklog is primarily workforce time tracking with project and task costing, rather than a general project planner alone. It records work sessions and activity, attributes time to tasks and projects, and can use billable time to prepare invoices. The existing catalog category is retained, but the evaluation should start with time capture and how those measurements will be interpreted.

Its dashboards distinguish time at work, activity-based productive time and time spent on assigned tasks. Those are different quantities. A project needing trusted client billing must also define billable status, rates and review of recorded hours; a displayed activity score does not itself establish the value or correctness of the deliverable.
description_zh:
Desklog 主要是结合项目和任务成本计算的员工工时跟踪服务，不能只理解为通用项目规划工具。它记录工作时段和活动，把时间归属到任务与项目，并可使用可计费工时准备发票。本文保留已有目录分类，但评估应从时间采集方式及如何解释这些指标开始。

其面板区分在岗时间、基于活动的“生产性”时间，以及分派任务所耗时间，这些数值含义不同。如果需要可信的客户计费，还必须定义可计费状态、费率和工时复核；活动分数本身不能证明交付物的价值或正确性。

core_features.explanation_zh: 选择客户、周期和项目以填入发票金额。

Compare activity records with task attribution during a time-tracking pilot.

在工时跟踪试点中比对活动记录与任务归属。

Capture model.zh: 文档中的桌面状态区分身份登录、网络连接和闲置活动。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Time at work is not the same as task time
sections.title_zh: 在岗时间不等于任务时间
sections.en:
The time-model help defines At Work as the logged-in workday interval, including active and inactive periods. Productive is based on system activity such as keyboard and mouse input. Task Spent concerns time attributed to assigned tasks. These are the vendor’s measurement definitions, not independent validation of employee productivity.

For a pilot, include a real task, a meeting away from the keyboard and an idle interval. Compare the timeline with the participant’s own record. Decide which metric answers the business question before using a summary or percentage; otherwise legitimate thinking or discussion may be interpreted through an unrelated activity measure.
sections.zh:
工时模型帮助将 At Work 定义为登录后的工作日时段，包括活跃与非活跃时间；Productive 基于键盘、鼠标等系统活动；Task Spent 则关注归属到已分派任务的时间。这些是厂商的指标定义，不是对员工生产力的独立验证。

试点应包含一项真实任务、一次离开键盘的会议和一段闲置时间，再将时间线与参与者自己的记录比对。使用汇总值或百分比前，应先明确业务问题对应哪个指标，否则可能用不相干的活动度指标解释合理思考或讨论。

sections.title_en: Define the billing basis before calculating an amount
sections.title_zh: 计算金额前先确定计费依据
sections.en:
A billable project can use a flat rate, one hourly rate or individual user hourly rates. A hypothetical project with two approved hours at USD 40/hour yields USD 80 before tax or adjustments; a fixed-fee project would instead follow its fixed amount. That calculation is illustrative and was not entered into Desklog.

Configure billable status and the rate deliberately, then verify a representative period. Time tracking and billing policy are separate: the presence of logged time does not decide whether the client agreed to pay for it. Avoid treating employee cost, client rate and project price as interchangeable numbers.
sections.zh:
可计费项目可以使用固定金额、统一小时费率或个人小时费率。假设某项目有两小时获准工时，费率为每小时 40 美元，则税费或调整前为 80 美元；固定总价项目则按其固定金额处理。这是说明性计算，没有输入 Desklog 执行。

应主动配置可计费状态与费率，并检查一个代表性时间段。时间跟踪和计费政策是两回事，记录了时间并不表示客户已同意付费。员工成本、客户费率和项目价格也不能混为一谈。

sections.title_en: An invoice needs a client, period and project selection
sections.title_zh: 发票需要客户、周期和项目选择
sections.en:
The invoicing guide starts by selecting a client and creating an invoice, then choosing the period and project, optionally using tags. It describes populating the billing type, hours, unit price and amount and adding payment details and adjustments before generation.

For an evaluation, compare the selected hours with the approved time record and verify the recipient and rate. Generate only a disposable example during testing. This documentation establishes invoice preparation, not that the invoice has been delivered, paid, reconciled or made compliant with every jurisdiction’s tax requirements.
sections.zh:
开票指南从选择客户并创建发票开始，再选择时间范围和项目，也可以使用标签。文档说明会填入计费类型、工时、单价和金额，在生成前还可添加付款信息和调整项。

评估时，应把选中的工时与获准记录比对，并核对收件方和费率。测试只使用可丢弃样例。这些文档能够证明发票准备流程，不能证明发票已经送达、支付、对账，或符合所有地区的税务要求。

sections.title_en: Optional screenshots add a separate data stream
sections.title_zh: 可选截图形成另一类数据
sections.en:
Desklog’s FAQ says screen capture is optional and available on Business and Enterprise, rather than enabled by default. The screenshot help describes periodic captures that may include active and idle screens; viewing and deleting them is limited to an admin or account owner in that guide.

Choose capture settings and access alongside time tracking instead of assuming they are the same feature. Verify what a participant and an administrator actually see. The existence of screenshots does not prove task completion; retain separate acceptance evidence for the deliverable. No screenshots were collected for this research.
sections.zh:
Desklog FAQ 说明，截图为 Business 和 Enterprise 提供的可选功能，并非默认启用。截图帮助描述了定期采集，可能包含活跃和闲置画面；该指南将查看和删除权限限定为管理员或账户所有者。

应在配置工时跟踪时单独决定采集设置和访问权，不能把两者视为同一功能。需要验证参与者和管理员各自看得到什么。截图存在不能证明任务完成，交付物仍需单独验收。本次研究没有采集截图。

sections.title_en: Logged out and disconnected are different states
sections.title_zh: 退出登录与断网是不同状态
sections.en:
The desktop-icon guide uses Offline for a user not logged into the app, and No Network for a connection problem preventing real-time synchronization. The FAQ separately describes tracking work without a network and syncing it after connectivity returns. These labels should not be collapsed into a promise that every untracked interval is automatically reconstructed.

Test a short network interruption while authenticated, then compare local and server timelines after reconnecting. Test logout separately. Determine who reviews missing or disputed intervals and how corrections affect billing. This profile did not verify buffering duration, retry behavior or data-loss recovery.
sections.zh:
桌面图标指南将 Offline 用于未登录应用的情况，将 No Network 用于连接问题导致无法实时同步。FAQ 另行描述了断网期间记录工作、恢复连接后同步的能力。不能把这些标签混成“所有未记录时段都会自动重建”的承诺。

建议在保持登录时测试一次短暂断网，重连后比对本地与服务器时间线，再单独测试退出登录。应明确谁复核缺失或争议时段，以及修正如何影响计费。本文没有验证缓存时长、重试行为或丢失数据恢复。

sections.title_en: Subscription, add-ons and hosting are separate decisions
sections.title_zh: 订阅、附加模块与托管分别判断
sections.en:
The pricing page caps Free at three users and distinguishes Business and Enterprise. Project billing appears in Business; project profit/loss and Kanban appear in Enterprise. Workflow, Payroll and Project Sprint are separately billed per-user add-ons. The retrieved text mixes currencies and billing selectors, so no normalized paid rate is asserted. A 14-day paid-feature trial is separate from ongoing Free use.

The FAQ offers a cloud-to-self-hosted switch through support; it does not establish installation requirements or license rights. Obtain those terms before selecting that deployment model. Treat app installation, account activation and participant setup as implementation work, not evidence that the whole product runs solely in a browser.
sections.zh:
定价页将 Free 限为三位用户，并区分 Business 和 Enterprise。项目计费列于 Business，项目盈亏与看板列于 Enterprise。Workflow、Payroll 和 Project Sprint 是按用户另行收费的附加模块。读取的文本混有币种和付款周期选择，因此本文不填写标准化付费单价。14 天付费功能试用与持续免费使用分开。

FAQ 提供通过支持团队从云端转为自托管的方式，但没有确立安装要求或许可权利，选用该部署方式前应取得对应条款。应用安装、账户激活和参与者配置都是实施工作，不能把整套产品描述为只在浏览器中运行。

sections.title_zh: 评估从工时到计费的小闭环
sections.en:
Shortlist Desklog when the central requirement is attributing work time to projects and reviewing billable effort. A practical pilot spans capture, a correction, rate selection and a sample invoice. Establish who owns each step and compare the invoice with the underlying time. This is editorial guidance, not a finding that monitoring increases output.

For teams seeking only task scheduling or document collaboration, first establish whether workforce activity measurement is needed at all. Specific Jira/ClickUp integrations, current supported operating-system versions, account behavior and real invoice delivery were not tested. The catalog’s project-management category is retained without extending the product into a general-purpose capability claim.
sections.zh:
当核心需求是把工时归属到项目并复核可计费投入时，可以将 Desklog 列入候选。建议试点覆盖采集、一次修正、费率选择和样例发票，明确各步骤负责人，再把发票与底层工时比对。这是编辑建议，不能据此认定监测会提高产出。

如果团队只需任务排期或文档协作，应先判断是否需要员工活动度测量。具体 Jira／ClickUp 集成、当前支持的操作系统版本、账户行为和真实发票送达均未测试。档案保留原项目管理分类，不将其扩展为无依据的通用能力宣称。

seo.title_en: Desklog: Time Metrics, Project Billing, Screenshots and Plan Limits
seo.title_zh: Desklog：工时指标、项目计费、截图与套餐边界
seo.description_en: Understand Desklog time categories, billable project rates, invoice preparation, optional screenshots and offline-state differences.
seo.description_zh: 了解 Desklog 工时分类、项目费率、发票准备、可选截图及不同离线状态。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate project time capture and billing.
secondary_questions: What is productive versus task time?
What happens during a network interruption?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses; no keyword volume or rankings measured.

research_gaps.en: Actual captured data, offline buffering, correction approvals and invoice delivery were not tested; activity metrics were not validated against output quality.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试真实采集数据、离线缓存、修正审批和发票送达，也未将活动指标与产出质量进行验证。

research_gaps.en: Exact paid rates, billing currency, supported OS versions, self-hosted requirements, license contract, interface languages and regional purchasing need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 具体付费费率、币种、受支持操作系统版本、自托管要求、许可合同、界面语言和地区购买仍需确认。
